# tinyfish

```go
import "github.com/kinorai/omnifeed/internal/search/tinyfish"
```

Package tinyfish implements domain.Searcher against the TinyFish Search API \(GET https://api.search.tinyfish.ai, X\-API\-Key header\). TinyFish answers with live Google\-grade results and returns structured filters SearXNG has to emulate: a domain allow\-list instead of a \`site:\` operator, a recency window in minutes, and a per\-result date.

Free tier, as of 2026\-10: 30 requests/minute and 12,000/day per key; past the daily allowance the API answers 402 until 00:00 UTC.

<a name="Config"></a>
## type Config

Config configures the Searcher.

```go
type Config struct {
    Endpoint string // defaults to DefaultEndpoint
    APIKey   string // required; sent as X-API-Key and never logged
    Client   *httpx.Client
    Logger   *slog.Logger
    // Limiter, when non-nil, paces queries to stay under the key's
    // requests-per-minute limit. Nil sends unpaced.
    Limiter httpx.Limiter
    // MaxWait caps how long a query may sit in the Limiter before it gives up.
    // Ignored when Limiter is nil. Defaults to defaultMaxWait.
    MaxWait time.Duration
    // Now is the clock relative dates ("5 hours ago") resolve against.
    // Defaults to time.Now; tests pin it.
    Now func() time.Time
}
```

<a name="Searcher.Search"></a>
### func \(\*Searcher\) Search

```go
func (s *Searcher) Search(ctx context.Context, query string, opts domain.SearchOptions) (domain.SearchReport, error)
```

Search runs the query against TinyFish and returns up to opts.Limit results. TinyFish is a single source, so its report is never Degraded: when it answers, it answered at full strength.
